pages.title: What it does
text: Right-click to bank 100 RPG experience directly (items.experience_crystal.xp = 100, configurable).
It goes through the very same booking path as kills and mining, so the xp_gain multiplier applies - exactly once.

pages.title: When to use it
text: When you want to rush the early levels. Note that it books the experience directly; no experience orbs are dropped.
